svg.title: What earns credit in ONC-AGI
svg.desc: A source-bound worked example from the scoring specification. Features a and b generate the outcome. Feature a2 is an accepted equivalent of a in the same cluster. L is measured after the outcome, with no causal arrow implied. The submissions [a, b] and [a2, a, b] both earn Find 1; [a, b, L] earns Find 0. These are worked-example values, not benchmark results.
svg.metadata: {"source":"ONC-AGI/docs/scoring.md, spec-w and its first, second and fifth scoring-example blocks","workflow":"image_gen composition and refinement followed by native reconstruction","boundary":"Selected relations only; other features in spec-w are omitted. Find is a world-level recovery term, not the aggregate Discovery Score.","fonts":"Archivo and Azeret Mono, instantiated from the project fonts; OFL licences accompany the source font instances in ../onc-style/fonts","palette":"ONC-AGI night navy and two band blues; significance red only for planted causes"}

g.text: One worked world · two recoverable parts
Equivalents count once. Listing a post-outcome feature makes Find zero.
